name: slug-input
title: Slug Input
description: Slug field that follows the title with proper transliteration (Straße → strasse) until published, reads back the full URL, checks collisions as you type with the next free slug one tap away, and warns that editing a live slug breaks links, keeping a redirect by default.

meta.summary: Keeps URL slugs clean and stable: proper transliteration, a full-URL readback, collision checks, and a warning before editing a live slug.
meta.server: Enforce slug uniqueness with a database constraint and create the old→new redirect server-side.
catches: Lossy slugify (ß, é and similar), by transliterating first
Slugs already taken, with the next free one suggested
Edits to a published slug that would break links
Removing the redirect from the old slug
Slugs too long, cut at a word boundary
limits: Collision check depends on your checkAvailability
Transliteration covers Latin-script letters; other scripts are dropped
Creating the redirect is your server's job
a11y: Visible <label> on the input; status via aria-describedby
Availability and warnings render in a polite live region
Keep-redirect is a labelled checkbox; icons are aria-hidden
